[2026-10-26] c:6417884182 comment by rreview:
Ralph found major issues at 7e4a0c57fca98407f7cca97886bdab23db6d0e4b.

**Default sendall inputs disable locktime activation** (src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp:1452, head)

When `sendall` selects inputs automatically and the deprecated replaceable override is not enabled, the new default makes `rbf` false and the automatic-input branch assigns `SEQUENCE_FINAL`. Final sequences disable `nLockTime`, so a caller-supplied nonzero locktime is ineffective. The same sequence prevents `FinishTransaction` from applying anti-fee-sniping; the existing default-path `wallet_sendall` test expects that behavior. The public `sendall` RPC is the triggering input path; no external application caller was checked.

[Full report](https://review.fish.foo/traces/35442-7e4a0c57fca98407f7cca97886bdab23db6d0e4b-1366-1.html)
